news.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo fouls out vs. Hornets as Heat tumble to 0-3
news.text: The Heat fell to 0-3 after a 115-110 loss to the undermanned Hornets in which Giannis Antetokounmpo scored just 14 points before fouling out.

news.title: Brandon Miller scores 34 points as the Hornets beat the winless Heat 115-110
news.text: — Brandon Miller scored 34 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the winless Miami Heat 115-110 on Saturday, bouncing back from one of the worst losses in franchise history a night earlier.

news.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo stays hot with 36 in loss, confident 0-2 Heat will click
news.text: Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 36 points Friday, giving him 71 through the first two games, and stayed hopeful the Heat would rebound from their winless start.

news.title: Pistons roll past Heat 128-111, adding to Miami's season-opening woes on defensive end
news.text: — John Collins scored 23 points, Paul Reed added 19 off the bench and the Detroit Pistons added to Miami's season-opening defensive misery by beating the Heat 128-111 on Friday night.

news.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo says Heat need to trust each other more after blowout loss
news.text: Following an opening night blowout loss to the Timberwolves, Giannis Antetokounmpo preached trust as the primary area that needs improvement for the new-look Heat.

news.title: Anthony Edwards scores 45, Wolves roll past Heat 131-106 to spoil Giannis' opener
news.text: — Anthony Edwards hit nine 3-pointers and scored 45 points to join an elite club, LaMelo Ball scored 21 in his Minnesota debut and the Timberwolves spoiled Giannis Antetokounmpo's first game with Miami by beating the Heat 131-106 on Wednesday night.
